Focus Entertainment and Saber Interactive are pleased to announce the release of Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2’s Decimation Update. Available now for all PlayStation 5 players, today’s update brings a new “Weekly Clash” game mode to the PvP-inclined, a new sector for the recently-introduced Chaos Siege Mode, as well as free cosmetics, weapons, and two cosmetic DLCs for Season Pass 3 holders.

Crossout Remastered - Track to the Future Update Trailer | PS5 & PS4 Games
https://store.playstation.com/concept/227108

The post-apocalyptic MMO action game Crossout has just received the “Track to the Future” major update, which continues the story of the Wasteland factions' struggle against the Ravagers — cold, calculating machines eager to destroy all that is left alive in the world of Crossout. This time the focus is set on the Dawn's Children faction and their new vehicle parts: plasma weapons, an engine, a cabin and the first-ever combination of hovers and wheels that are capable of switching their movement mode on the go!
